user.title: Choose the cover
user.description: Select the entity to link. The new cover will be placed under the same device and will show its current position.

data_description.source_entity: The cover entity that receives the commands.

parametres.title: Cover settings
parametres.description: Real cover: {source}. Time a complete trip of the cover, fully closed to fully open and back.

data.name: Cover name
data.take_over: Take over the name and identifier of the original cover
data.disable_other_entities: Disable the other entities of the original device

data_description.name: The name shown in Home Assistant. Keep the name of the original cover to take over its identifier (see below).
data_description.travel_time_up: Seconds needed for a complete opening (0 to 100 %).
data_description.travel_time_down: Seconds needed for a complete closing (100 to 0 %).
data_description.send_stop_at_ends: Once opening or closing is complete, still sends a stop command. This is only useful if the cover does not stop by itself at the end of its travel. When in doubt, don't use it.
data_description.device_class: The type of equipment (shutter, blind, door…). It determines the icon.
data_description.hide_source: The original cover no longer appears in Home Assistant's automatic screens. It is still used internally to run the commands, and it appears again if you remove this entity.
data_description.take_over: On: the new cover takes the name and identifier of the original one (for example cover.kitchen_shutter), and the original is renamed with the suffix below. Your scripts and automations then use the new cover without any change. Off: the new cover gets a different identifier (for example cover.kitchen_shutter_2) and your scripts must be edited to use it. The exchange only happens if the name entered above is the name of the original cover.
data_description.source_suffix: Added to the name and identifier of the original cover when it is renamed (for example "source" gives "Kitchen Shutter (source)" and cover.kitchen_shutter_source). No effect if the option above is off.
data_description.disable_other_entities: Disables all the other entities of the original device (for example Somfy's "My Position" or "Identify" buttons, which move the cover without going through this one and make it lose position tracking). The original cover stays enabled: it receives the commands. Careful: the device's sensors (battery, power…) are disabled too. Everything is enabled again if you untick the option or remove this cover.

positions.name: Preset positions
positions.description: A preset position creates a button that moves the cover to that position, placed under the same device. Unlike an original button such as Somfy's "My Position", the position stays up to date. The positions also become the favorites in the cover's control dialog, between 0 % and 100 % (max. 8 positions).

error.suffixe_invalide: Enter a suffix made of letters or digits.
error.positions_invalides: Each preset position needs a name and a percentage between 0 and 100.
error.noms_en_double: This name is already used for a position of this cover.

init.title: Cover settings
init.description: Changes apply immediately. The current position is kept. The name and the name exchange can only be set when the cover is created.
